response.justification: Bogdan substantially exceeds the 6+ year requirement with 20+ years of software development experience and is currently a Staff-level engineer at re:cinq working on full-stack AI-agent infrastructure. He demonstrates strong alignment with the primary tech stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React) and has direct experience with AI agent development. His background includes proven expertise in architecture and scalability from Dunnhumby (millions of requests/second) and multiple senior roles. While Nest.js and Vitest are not explicitly mentioned in the resume, his deep TypeScript/Node.js fundamentals and testing-focused mindset make these learnable gaps. His demonstrated problem-solving abilities and knowledge-sharing through open source contributions further strengthen his candidacy.
strengths: Substantially exceeds experience requirement with 20+ years in software development and current Staff-level role at re:cinq doing this exact work
Strong alignment with primary tech stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React) and active experience with AI-agent infrastructure development and MCP frameworks
Proven architecture and scalability expertise demonstrated by Dunnhumby experience (millions of requests/second) and complex system design across multiple senior roles
concerns: Nest.js not mentioned in resume despite being listed as primary stack requirement; experience is primarily with Node.js and GraphQL
Vitest not specifically mentioned; while testing and TDD practices are evident, this specific framework is absent from documented experience
PostgreSQL not mentioned; resume shows MongoDB and MySQL experience but lacks clarity on relational database depth; cloud platform experience limited to AWS CDK

key_factors.factor: Years of experience and current role level
Core tech stack presence (TypeScript, Node.js, React, AI agents)
Missing specific frameworks (Nest.js, Vitest) and PostgreSQL expertise
